items.title: Gambia receives roadmap for national decarbonisation toward 2063
items.description: An AU-backed roadmap sets out long-term emissions and renewable-energy targets for The Gambia; implementation and financing remain the test.
items.altText: Schematic editorial map and data graphic for The Gambia’s decarbonisation roadmap, showing solar, energy and long-term planning pathways.

items.title: UN report documents 1,167 killings in Haiti in third quarter
items.description: A BINUH report covering 1 July–30 September records 1,167 people killed and 459 injured amid gang attacks, security operations and self-defence incidents.
items.altText: Editorial data graphic summarizing the BINUH third-quarter Haiti report, with counts for people killed and injured and a schematic map motif.

items.title: Sheriff elections put local immigration agreements in focus
items.description: An AP review of roughly 250 sheriff races examined where 287(g) agreements featured in campaigns; official and local results show the issue’s local political stakes.
items.altText: Schematic U.S. election and immigration-enforcement graphic showing a ballot, a local sheriff badge and a 287(g) agreement label.

items.title: Analysis: Southern organizers are building a longer Black political bench
items.description: Across Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina and Mississippi, organizers are trying to connect voter registration to candidate recruitment and durable local power.
items.altText: Schematic map-style illustration connecting Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina and Mississippi to a candidate-recruitment pathway.

items.title: Brazil data shows income gap among Black women reporting violence
items.description: A data update reported by Agência Brasil says 73% of Black women reporting domestic or family violence lived in households earning up to two minimum wages, compared with 54% of white women.
items.altText: Editorial bar chart comparing the reported 73 percent and 54 percent household-income figures for Black and white women in Brazil’s violence data update.

items.title: French court recognizes racist nature of violence in Michel Zecler case
items.description: Three officers received prison sentences in the case arising from the 2020 beating of the Black music producer; the court’s reasoning remains the key legal record.
items.altText: Editorial courtroom timeline graphic for the Michel Zecler case, connecting the 2020 arrest, video evidence and the reported 2026 court ruling.

items.title: Mauritius hosts Indian Ocean regional health forum
items.description: The 22nd colloquium on HIV, hepatitis and addictions brought regional health stakeholders together in Quatre-Bornes from 18 to 20 November.
items.altText: Schematic Indian Ocean network graphic connecting Mauritius with regional health partners around a forum on HIV, hepatitis and addictions.
